text:
mira: ACME asks for parity: per-route monthly spend caps, tenant model pinning, and tiered latency SLAs. pilot requested ~6w. can we scope an MVP?

alex: summary: policy surface + gateway enforcement + telemetry + UI. avoid billing changes for MVP (soft-blocks).

sam: gateway approach: estimate input tokens -> cost estimate -> if over cap try fallback models -> if none, return clear error. easy to implement as a gateway hook.

joan: product object: RoutingProfile {name, preferred_model, monthly_cap_cents, p95_ms, fallback_list, pin_version}. keep minimal.

ben: ops risk: metrics cardinality. mitigate with pilot limits (3 profiles/tenant) + sampling. need per-invocation audit logs for disputes.

tess: sales wants demoable behavior; model pinning is non-negotiable.

legal-bot: note: pilot SLAs must be non-contractual; Legal review required before external demo.

mira: actions: @sam spike gateway by EOD, @joan mockups, @ben infra estimate, @tess collect ACME prompts. meeting Fri 9am to finalize.

deploy-bot: branch created: feature/spend-cap-routing (sam).
